features.title: Serve session search from a worker-owned index
features.summary: Replace the stock sessionQuery backend: searches are pure reads forwarded to a worker that owns the SQLite FTS5 index and ingests session logs incrementally, while list, read and title reads stay core's own code with cached folds.
failureModes: Filters the backend cannot serve are refused with SESSION_QUERY_INVALID_FILTER rather than silently ignored.
An interrupted ingest resumes from the stored per-log cursor instead of restarting the corpus.

User text is never FTS5 syntax: every word is quoted (apostrophes, quotes, AND/OR/NEAR, a leading -), a quoted phrase stays one phrase, a trailing * is a prefix search, and text with nothing searchable answers no match instead of an error.

verification.testName: lists Sessions once until one is created, disposed, or a listed header changes
folds a Session title once until that Session appends an event
searches apostrophes, quotes and fts5 operators in user text literally

verification.reason: The bundle replaces a Host service backend and renders no UI of its own; the palette and memory finder that call it are verified by their own catalogs, and the cached reads are unit-tested in src/engine-listing.test.ts and src/engine-titles.test.ts.

features.title: Find every match in one thread
features.summary: Return every current-surface event of one Session whose indexed text has all the words typed (the last as a prefix), in transcript order with a short snippet, for the Chat find bar and the session_find_in_thread agent tool. An archived Session is indexed for that request.
features.currentSurface: host: session-search findInThread API and session_find_in_thread tool
failureModes: Text without a letter or digit returns no matches instead of an FTS5 syntax error.
When another plugin owns sessionQuery, ownsService is false and the caller says the index does not serve the profile.

verification.testName: returns every matching current event of one Session in seq order, with a snippet
reads the owned worker index through the Effect API bridge

verification.reason: The find bar that calls this API belongs to @dshfiles/chat and is walked by its own journey.

features.title: Search the prompts sent across threads
features.summary: Serve the newest prompts a person sent across every top-level thread, newest first and each text once, from a time-ordered user_prompts table beside the FTS index: bounded by a window of newest prompts and a size cap, optionally narrowed to prompts holding every typed word. Subagent threads and plugin- or agent-sent messages are left out.
failureModes: Prompts indexed before the human/plugin flag existed are kept (flag unknown) until their thread is indexed again.
A prompt longer than the index's 65 536-character cap was truncated and never becomes a history row.
When another plugin owns sessionQuery, ownsService is false and prompt-stash shows how to add the plugin.

verification.testName: lists the prompts people sent across threads, newest first and each text once
narrows to prompts holding every word, keeps only the newest window and skips oversized or truncated prompts
drops a thread’s prompts when the thread is reindexed or forgotten

verification.reason: The history tab that calls this API belongs to @dshfiles/prompt-stash and is walked by its own journey.
